fixed: A figure shorthand typed with a count over 64 beats, like `pbs (100)`, no longer adds a figure with beats outside the range a figure can take. The line is kept as a custom figure with your text, as for any other figure. A count of five digits or more, like `pbs (10000)`, is kept in the figure's note with the beats the shorthand was saved with.

Free-text entry holds the count typed with a one-figure shorthand to the taxonomy's 0..64 beats range, and reads a count too long to be beats (`splitShorthandCount(...).unread`) as a note on the figure, as it does for a line with no shorthand (#1879).
